# StringHeight <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
StringHeight:Int32 string:String
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `string` | In | String | required | The text to measure. |

**Returns:** The height of the text.

## Description

The height in pixels that a text has in the current font.

## Differences

* Text has only one line, so this is always the height of one character.
